task_definition.title: Shell-extract bridge γ — shell-extract::extract ComputeNode target + trampoline + registration
task_definition.description:
PRD: docs/prds/v0_4/shell-extract-engine-bridge.md task γ (§9 Phase 2 — ComputeNode trampoline slice, no FEA yet).

Register the "shell-extract::extract" ComputeNode target with its Rust trampoline, so a ComputeNode on a synthetic slab geometry materializes a ShellExtractionResult in the output ValueCell (and re-runs hit the in-memory ComputeNode cache).

User-observable signal: Engine integration test in crates/reify-eval/tests/ pins — (a) registering the trampoline; (b) inserting a ComputeNode with target "shell-extract::extract" on a synthetic slab geometry, observing a ShellExtractionResult materialize in the output ValueCell; (c) a second run hits the in-memory ComputeNode cache (dispatch-count instrumentation per compute-node-contract §7.2); (d) failure-mapping test injecting an invalid threshold asserts ComputeOutcome::Failed with E_SHELL_BAD_THRESHOLD.

Consumer: PRD task δ (FEA auto-classification dispatch — note: δ was filed as task 3551 then CANCELLED; its work folds into ζ=3596 / θ=3598) reads the extracted mid-surface mesh + segmentation through this ComputeNode upstream of solver::elastic_static. PRD task ζ=3596 (TopologyAttributeTable fold-in) depends on this. PRD task α=3592 (ShellExtractionResult type, done) names this γ trampoline as its downstream ComputeNode consumer.

Crates touched: reify-eval (engine_compute.rs::register_compute_fns gains a register_shell_extract_compute_fns(engine) call; new file crates/reify-eval/src/shell_extract_compute.rs holding shell_extract_compute_fn), reify-shell-extract (consumed engine-side: compute_medial_mask → extract_mid_surface → prune_branches → mesh_mid_surface → segment_regions → populate_mid_surface_attributes pipeline; no new deps), reify-types (Diagnostic variants if not already present).

Trampoline contract (PRD §5): signature per compute-node-contract §4 — value_inputs=[options: ElasticOptions], realization_inputs=[body_geom], unused options/prior_warm_state, cancellation handle. Polls cancellation between phases (medial-mask, mid-surface, pruning, segmentation, naming). On any *Error variant returns ComputeOutcome::Failed { diagnostics } mapped per §7. On success returns Completed { result: shell_extraction_result.to_value(), new_warm_state: None, cost_per_byte: derived, diagnostics: [] }. No warm state (one-shot per (geometry, options)). Cache key = (target, value_inputs_hash, realization_inputs_hash, options_value_hash). Wires producer-side reify-shell-extract symbols that G-tool flags as Type-A orphans (scripts/audit-orphan-producers.sh baseline 2026-05-12); once landed, no // G-allow: markers required.

Prereqs (per PRD §9): α=3592 (done — ShellExtractionResult type). Cross-PRD: compute-node-contract §8 task γ = task 3422 (per-Engine dispatch registry, DONE) provides register_compute_fns. Note δ=3551 cancelled — its FEA dispatch consumption is no longer the immediate downstream; γ stands on its own producer-side ComputeNode slice.

Grammar: existing — no new Reify-level syntax (grammar_confirmed=true).
